# YojiLabs

> YojiLabs is a custom software and automation studio. We build operations systems, internal tools, and integrations around real business workflows — starting with hospitality and service businesses.

Contact: hello@yojilabs.com

- [Home](https://yojilabs.com/): What we build and how we work.
- [Demos](https://yojilabs.com/demos): One working product (Kitchen Inventory / Pantry) and two scoped concepts.
- [Kitchen Inventory demo](https://yojilabs.com/demos/kitchen-inventory): Guided walkthrough of the live Pantry app with sample data.
- [Start a project](https://yojilabs.com/start-a-project): Book a call or send project details.
- [Contact](https://yojilabs.com/contact)
